claim: AWS recommends keeping all resources out of the management account, because SCPs do not restrict any users or roles in the management account.
question: Why does AWS recommend running no workloads in the management account?

values.display: keep them out of the management account
do not work to restrict any users or roles

evidence.quote: Store all of your AWS resources in other AWS accounts in the organization and keep them out of the management account. One important reason to keep your resources in other accounts is because Organizations service control policies (SCPs) do not work to restrict any users or roles in the management account.
